steps.title: Open Tapeology
steps.narration: Let's start on Tapeology's home page.
steps.point_out: The navigation bar across the top lists every section of the app, including Structure.

steps.title: Open the Structure page
steps.narration: Clicking Structure takes us to the page where a symbol's key price levels live.
steps.point_out: The Symbol, As-of, and Load controls are waiting for input, with a plain message explaining what to do next.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time, then Load, to see its S/R levels and confluence zones.

steps.title: Meet the new Registry section
steps.narration: Without clicking anything, a new Registry section has already loaded further down this same page, led by a Champion badge.
steps.point_out: The badge shows v1 on the default profile, with a note confirming it matches the same champion shown on the Performance page.

expect.text: Confirmed identical to the champion served by GET /research/profiles — one store pointer, two read views.

steps.title: See the v1 strategy, honestly
steps.narration: Right below the badge sits a card for v1, the app's original strategy, listing its entry and exit rules exactly as the system defines them.
steps.point_out: There's no reward-target row on this card — v1 genuinely doesn't use one, so the page leaves it out instead of showing a blank or a fake zero.

steps.title: See structure_tape's extra detail
steps.narration: The second card, structure_tape, lists the same kind of rules, plus a reward target this strategy actually uses.
steps.point_out: Three small tables underneath show how its stop distance, reward target, and position size all scale across zone classes A, B, and C.

steps.title: Try a symbol
steps.narration: Now let's revisit the older part of this page and type in a stock symbol.
steps.point_out: PG appears in the Symbol field.

steps.title: Set an as-of time
steps.narration: Adding a point in time completes the query.

steps.title: Load PG's levels, honestly
steps.narration: Clicking Load asks the app for this symbol's price history — this iteration specifically re-confirmed this older feature still tells the truth instead of ever faking a chart.
steps.point_out: Since this environment hasn't recorded price history for PG, the page says so plainly, with no blank screen and no invented chart.

expect.text: No bar series recorded for PG.

steps.title: Confirm Performance still agrees
steps.narration: Finally, let's check the Performance page, which has shown its own champion badge since before this iteration.
steps.point_out: Its Champion box still reads v1 and default, and the Profile registry list underneath is intact — nothing about the new Structure section leaked in or broke anything here.
